import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 20

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture20

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 20](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, `b(G) ≥ n(G) / ⌊deg_avg(G)⌋`, where `b(G)` is
the size of a largest induced bipartite subgraph, `n(G)` is the number of vertices,
and `deg_avg(G) = (∑ v, deg(v)) / n(G)` is the average degree.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture20 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let deg_avg : ℝ := (∑ v : α, (G.degree v : ℝ)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)
    (Fintype.card α : ℝ) / (⌊deg_avg⌋ : ℝ) ≤ (b G : ℝ) := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The number of vertices of `K₃` is 3. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : Fintype.card (Fin 3) = 3 := by decide

/-- The average degree of `K₃` is 2 (every vertex has degree 2 in the complete graph on 3 vertices). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : averageDegree (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) = 2 := by
  unfold averageDegree; simp [Fintype.card_fin]

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture20

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, all-conjectures page, Conjectures 20 and 50 and their remarks: http://web.archive.org/web/20260723161800id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html
WOWII introduction and discussion of induced-subgraph invariants: http://web.archive.org/web/20240726225242id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowii/list.htm

review.notes: Checked the conjecture and both sanity checks. The source states exactly b(G) ≥ n/FLOOR[deg_avg(G)], with the same meanings of b, n, average degree and floor. It labels Conjecture 20 T* and includes it in the resolved-true list, consistent with `research solved`. The live cited host was unavailable, so the source was read through archived primary pages. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, verified that the supremum defining b is attained, proved positivity of both denominators under the theorem's hypotheses, and checked rational/real arithmetic agreement. Direct instances for K₂, K₃ and P₃ compile. Exhaustive computation found no failures for all 771 connected labelled graphs on 2–5 vertices; the executable test was proved equivalent to the exact real-valued conclusion without using the conjecture. Empty and singleton definition values were also checked. No repository files were edited.
